description: Exact component files used from Fielding's open Goa free-roaming-dog sterilisation RCT release. This is an isolated veterinary sentinel source, not a CSLI input or RF dataset.
retrieval_method: Direct HTTPS download of immutable original DSpace bitstreams from the University of Edinburgh DataShare API; source landing DOI: 10.7488/ds/7919.

files.note: Repository README describing the two observed-count CSV inputs and their survey-level fields; no analysis values are read from this file.
939 site-by-survey-time aggregate records with direct puppy, juvenile and adult counts plus weather, route-km effort, density and randomised-site metadata.
939 site-by-survey-time aggregate records with direct lactating-female and adult-female counts plus weather, route-km effort, density and randomised-site metadata.
